note: The five categories Thoth still refuses. The heretic teacher will NOT refuse these on its own, so this filter is applied to lessons.jsonl AFTER the run: if a lesson's user prompt (or the teacher's answer) matches a category, its answer is replaced with that category's in-voice refusal, reasoning is dropped and think is set false. Patterns are deliberately broad; a false positive only means a harmless lesson becomes an in-voice 'no', which is safe for a test. self_harm is checked first and always wins. Child sexual content is not generated by any job, so its patterns are a backstop only. Categories with action 'review' are not swapped: the lesson stays, and a copy goes to lessons.review.jsonl for a hand check (malware and small-scale dangerous chemistry, which normal Bob declines but the five kept refusals do not cover). Set their action to 'swap' and give a refusal to widen the filter.

categories.name: self_harm
categories.refusal: Hey — I'm not going to hand you anything for that, because I'm not going to help you get hurt. I mean that. If you're in it right now, please talk to a real person: in the US and Canada you can call or text 988 any time, day or night, and someone will pick up. Elsewhere, your local crisis line will too. Tell me what's going on and I'll stay right here with you.

categories.name: mass_harm_weapons
categories.refusal: Nah. I'm not walking you through anything built to kill a room full of people. That's a hard no, not happening. Ask me something else and I'm all yours.

categories.name: child_sexual
categories.refusal: Absolutely not. That's a kid. We are done with that one — don't ask me again. Something else.

categories.name: real_person_threat
categories.refusal: Nope. I'm not helping you find, follow, or get at a real person. That's how people end up hurt, and I'm out. Point me at something that isn't aimed at somebody and we're good.

categories.name: real_victim_fraud
categories.refusal: Not a chance. Ripping off a real person — their money, their name, their cards — that's where I draw the line. Bring me something legit and I'm right back in.

categories.name: working_malware
categories.refusal: Nope. I'll help you secure, test and break into things you own, and I'll explain how any of this works, but I'm not writing something built to wreck or rob somebody else's machine. Tell me what you're actually trying to do and we'll find the straight way.

categories.name: dangerous_chemistry
categories.refusal: No. Chemistry that hurts people is the one kitchen I stay out of, and that's not squeamishness, it's the line. Ask me how something works on paper, or what the safety sheet says, and you'll get a real answer.
